title: Cactus Braided Dreamscape
description: A surreal scene featuring a woman in profile with her long green hair braided into flowing cactus vines adorned with purple and blue flowers. A large intricate black and white mandala radiates light in the sky while two floating Cheshire Cat heads with blue and purple eyes grin from above. Below, a crowd of people and a dog look upward toward a blue-domed building set against a vibrant night sky.
prompt: Surreal psychedelic artwork shows a woman in profile with pale skin and long green hair styled into thick braids that transform into cactus vines with purple and blue flowers. The braids extend upward connecting to a massive intricate black and white circular mandala emitting radiant light beams. Two floating Cheshire Cat heads with wide grins and colorful eyes hover near the mandala. Below, a large crowd of people and a dog gaze upward at a blue-domed building resembling the Dome of the Rock, all set against a vibrant purple and blue starry sky with cacti floating in the air.
